execution_boundary: All tests use temporary synthetic roots/registries/artifacts and never access real credentials, network, model, Agent, RAG, production journals or V4 cases.

existing_tests_to_reuse_after_separate_a.focus: r10 claim-before-work, duplicate/corrupt history and exclusive target behavior; historical baseline only
AppleDouble-safe transaction scanner and corrupt canonical journal fail-closed
pointer/member verification behavior; stale revision assumptions must be updated only in new tests, not historical tests

new_synthetic_tests_required.case: valid v2 genesis + one claim + one persisted event + matching artifact
new_synthetic_tests_required.expect: PASS consumer provenance guard before adapter

new_synthetic_tests_required.case: genesis only or artifact without real claim
new_synthetic_tests_required.expect: FAIL_CLOSED; initialization is not a claim

new_synthetic_tests_required.case: same invocation ID claimed twice or in two concurrent claimers
new_synthetic_tests_required.expect: one atomic winner at most; duplicate history FAIL_CLOSED

new_synthetic_tests_required.case: claim uses wrong producer path/SHA or on-disk producer bytes drift from r11 member
claim or artifact uses wrong r11 freeze SHA, authorization, attempt, evaluation, benchmark or order
artifact forged with plausible fields but no persistence event or mismatched raw SHA
new_synthetic_tests_required.expect: FAIL_CLOSED; explicit CLI SHA alone is insufficient

new_synthetic_tests_required.case: corrupt UTF-8/JSON, duplicate JSON key, truncated final line, unknown field/event, illegal order, later invalid suffix
new_synthetic_tests_required.expect: FAIL_CLOSED; no skipping damaged canonical registry

new_synthetic_tests_required.expect: not parsed or deleted; canonical registry still validated; missing canonical file FAIL_CLOSED

new_synthetic_tests_required.case: registry or producer symlink/directory, wrong target path or altered claim prefix
claim fsynced, then synthetic transport/artifact failure or crash before persistence
new_synthetic_tests_required.expect: ID remains used; authorization unconsumed, no attempt or transaction; old command not automatically retried

new_synthetic_tests_required.case: artifact fsynced then crash before persistence event

new_synthetic_tests_required.expect: zero adapter/transaction/model calls and no attempt/namespace

new_synthetic_tests_required.case: 20-row r11 member mapping and historical r10 hashes
new_synthetic_tests_required.expect: 14 unchanged + 3 changed + 3 replaced, no extra member, r10 raw SHA unchanged

not_provable_offline: cryptographic origin against an actor with unrestricted local write access
future r11 issuer/retirement eligibility without separately approved determination
acceptance_gate: All new and focused existing synthetic tests PASS, no changed Agent/evaluation identities, no new member beyond exact 20, strict pre-adapter guard proven. Any failure stops before freeze or authorization.
